h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Amravati

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Amravati

items.pText: Buying a playground is the easy part. Keeping it safe and good-looking for years is what most Amravati buyers ask us about. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, housing societies, temple trusts and municipal gardens in Amravati. We make it at our factory in Vasai, about 540 km away, and send it to Vidarbha by road for installation by our team or a dealer.

Amravati's summers are long and very hot, and the monsoon follows with steady rain from June. Heat dries out grease in moving parts and fades colours left in full sun, while rain tests every bolt and joint. Our galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty, and springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year. These cover manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions. The routine below covers most of what a caretaker needs to do.

items.q: How often should playground equipment be checked?
items.a: Sweep and wipe it weekly, and check bolts and moving parts every month. Inspect the base and flooring before and after the monsoon. We share a maintenance guide at handover.

items.q: Who do we call for spare parts in Amravati?
items.a: Our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry a 1-year warranty.

items.q: Does strong sun damage playground colours?
items.a: Long exposure to strong sun can fade any outdoor colour over time. Placing equipment where it gets some shade, and keeping it clean, helps it hold its look for longer.
